entries.doc_checked: CRCW01005 e3, Rev 28-Oct-13 (4 pp.); covers 01005/RR0402M only - matches entry.

proposals.evidence: p1 Technical specs 'Rated Dissipation P70 (1) W 0.031'; p1 note (1) 'The rated dissipation applies only if the permitted film temperature of 125 °C is not exceeded'; p2 Derating figure: 100 % to 70 °C, 0 % at 125 °C (visually read).
proposals.method: Rth = (125 - 70) K / 0.031 W = 1774.2 K/W. Linear derating means film/element temperature = T_amb + Rth*P reaches the endpoint on the derating line, so Rth_implied = (T_end - T_knee)/P_rated. This is the derating-implied thermal resistance on the manufacturer's (unstated) reference mounting, not a measured or board-specific value. Note the 01005 endpoint is 125 °C, not the class default 155 °C.

proposals.evidence: p1 'Permissible film temperature, ϑF max. 155 °C'; p1 'The rated dissipation applies only if the permitted film temperature is not exceeded'; P70 (standard) for CRCW0402 = 0.063 W (p2); p6 Derating figure: CRCW0402 line flat at 0.063 W to 70 °C, reaching 0 W at 155 °C (visually read).
proposals.method: Rth = (155 - 70) K / 0.063 W = 1349.2 K/W.
